cancelLabel.description: Label for the cancelling action. Defaults to `'Cancel'`.

destructive.description: Marks the confirming action as destructive. Defaults to `false`.

flush.description:
The strip sits flush inside a bordered container. At the container's start or end it drops
its own rule there instead of doubling the container's edge. Defaults to `false`.

open.description:
Whether the confirmation is open. Bindable, and component-owned on
close: confirming, clicking Cancel, and pressing Escape all set this
to `false` before calling `onConfirm`/`onCancel`, so a bound parent
observes the confirmation as already closed by the time either
callback runs—neither callback can veto or delay that close. Defaults
to `false`.

presentation.description: The in-flow strip (default) or a single guarded action button.

armed.description: Bindable armed state for two-press presentation.

requestKey.description: Request identity; changing it disarms two-press presentation.

blocked.description: Blocks interaction while keeping the action focusable for an explanatory reason.

requiresSecondPress.description: Requires a second press; defaults to `true` in two-press presentation.

ariaDisabled.description: Explicit aria-disabled value for a blocked action.

armedLabel.description: Full accessible label shown after the first press.

armedHint.description: Status text shown while the two-press action is armed.

armedEscapeHint.description: Optional keyboard instruction shown beside the armed status on fine pointers.

loading.description: Shows a loading state on the action button.

loadingLabel.description: Accessible loading label for the action button.

ariaDescribedBy.description: Id referenced by the action button's aria-describedby.

class.description: Additional class merged with the component's root class.

hintClass.description: Additional class merged with the two-press status hint.

hintId.description: Id assigned to the two-press status hint.

unsupportedProps.name: children
unsupportedProps.description: Additional content rendered below the prompt, above the confirm/cancel actions, while the confirmation is open.

unsupportedProps.name: onCancel
unsupportedProps.description: Called when the user cancels the action (via the Cancel action or Escape), after `open` is already set to `false`.

unsupportedProps.name: onConfirm
unsupportedProps.description: Called when the user confirms the action, after `open` is already set to `false`.
